English: A powerful Drill with an additional Assault mode used for attacking enemy ground troops and breaching structures.
Chinese (simplified): 一把强大的钻头，带有额外的突击模式，用于攻击敌方地面部队和突破建筑。

English: Unlocks the ability to craft light arms as well as ship weapons and turrets.
Chinese (simplified): 解锁制作轻武器以及飞船武器和炮塔的能力。

English: Unlocks the ability to craft resource gathering tools and equipment, multitools, as well as thrusters and other high-tech devices for ships and structures.
Chinese (simplified): 解锁制作资源采集工具和设备、多功能工具，以及用于飞船和建筑的推进器和其他高科技设备的能力。

English: Unlocks the ability to craft devices that can aid in exploration, as well as small vessel devices for light scout ships.
Chinese (simplified): 解锁制作有助于探索的设备以及用于轻型侦察飞船的小型飞船设备的能力。

English: Unlocks the ability to craft advanced medicines and medical devices.
Chinese (simplified): 解锁制作先进药物和医疗设备的能力。

English: A highly advanced Small Vessel Detector that can scan entire planets and sectors at a time.
Chinese (simplified): 一种高度先进的小型飞船探测器，可一次扫描整个星球和星区。

English: The most advanced Detector, this device allows discovery of an entire planet or sector with just one ping. However, it takes a long time to recharge.
Chinese (simplified): 最先进的探测器，只需一次脉冲即可发现整个星球或星区。但需要很长时间充电。

English: All-in-one Med-kit that Restores around [c][ffffff]450 health[-][/c]. Use LMB from the toolbar or from Inventory with Shift+RMB.
Chinese (simplified): 一体式医疗包，可恢复约[c][ffffff]450点生命[-][/c]。在工具栏中使用左键或从物品栏中使用Shift+右键。

English: A specialized device that can be used to scout out an area. Acts as a Detector and a Scope.
Chinese (simplified): 一种专门用于侦察区域的设备。兼具探测器和瞄准镜功能。

English: Used to attack creatures and structures, capable of damaging any material. Can be use to harvest wood.
Chinese (simplified): 用于攻击生物和建筑，能够破坏任何材料。可用于采集木材。

English: This Detector not only has a longer range than any other Hover Vessel Detector, but also immediately identifies anyting it detects.
Chinese (simplified): 此探测器不仅比任何其他悬浮飞船探测器的范围更远，而且能立即识别检测到的任何东西。

English: An gravity-based propulsion system that provides horizontal thrust in multiple directions.
Chinese (simplified): 一种基于重力的推进系统，提供多个方向的水平推力。

English: Powerful Small Thruster unit for providing lift.
Chinese (simplified): 用于提供升力的强大小型推进器单元。

English: Powerful Small Thruster unit for descending.
Chinese (simplified): 用于下降的强大小型推进器单元。
改进型引力子推进驱动器
先进引力子推进驱动器

English: An advancement on the Short Range Warp Drive, the Mid-Range Warp Drive is capable of traveling to nearby star systems.
Chinese (simplified): 中程翘曲引擎是短程翘曲引擎的升级版，能够前往附近的恒星系统。

English: This Small Vessel Warp Drive has been specially modified to explore deep space. Not only can it go further than most Capital Vessel Warp Drives, but it also uses no pentaxid when warping within a solar system.
Chinese (simplified): 这艘小型飞船翘曲引擎经过特殊改装以探索深空。它不仅比大多数主力舰翘曲引擎飞得更远，而且在太阳系内翘曲时不消耗五亚甲素。

English: An enhancement to the Warp Drive that not only increases the range of the warp capability, but reduces Pentaxid use when traveling long distances.
Chinese (simplified): 对翘曲引擎的增强，不仅增加翘曲能力的范围，还减少长途旅行时的五亚甲素消耗。

English: Will warm you up or cool you down if you are close enough to the device. Can only change temperature up to a maximum limit! Will also reduce Radiation.
Chinese (simplified): 如果你足够接近该设备，它会让你变暖或变凉。只能改变温度到最大极限！也会减少辐射。

English: A Light Environmental Suit that only servers to provide Oxygen in an unbreathable atmosphere.\n--\n[c][ff4040]Note: This armor requires an Armor Locker to equip.[-][/c]
Chinese (simplified): 一种轻型环境防护服，仅用于在不可呼吸的大气中提供氧气。\n--\n[c][ff4040]注意：此装甲需要装甲柜来装备。[-][/c]

English: A Light Armor that provides improved protection from temperature and radiation.\n--\nNote: This a can be equipped in the player inventory ([c][44ff00]TAB[-][/c])
Chinese (simplified): 一种轻型装甲，提供改进的温度和辐射防护。\n--\n注意：此装甲可以在玩家物品栏中装备（[c][44ff00]TAB[-][/c]）

English: Scout armor is designed to make it easier to move and get around obstacles.\n--\n[c][ff4040]Note: This armor requires an Armor Locker to equip.[-][/c]
Chinese (simplified): 侦察装甲旨在让移动和绕过障碍物更容易。\n--\n[c][ff4040]注意：此装甲需要装甲柜来装备。[-][/c]

English: Scout armor is designed to make it easier to move and get around obstacles.\n--\nNote: This a can be equipped in the player inventory ([c][44ff00]TAB[-][/c])
Chinese (simplified): 侦察装甲旨在让移动和绕过障碍物更容易。\n--\n注意：此装甲可以在玩家物品栏中装备（[c][44ff00]TAB[-][/c]）

English: Combat Armor is reinforced to better protect the wearer from damage, and it is more durable.\n--\nNote: This a can be equipped in the player inventory ([c][44ff00]TAB[-][/c])
Chinese (simplified): 战斗装甲经过强化，能更好地保护穿戴者免受伤害，并且更耐用。\n--\n注意：此装甲可以在玩家物品栏中装备（[c][44ff00]TAB[-][/c]）

English: Combat Armor is reinforced to better protect the wearer from damage, and it is more durable.\n--\n[c][ff4040]Note: This armor requires an Armor Locker to equip.[-][/c]
Chinese (simplified): 战斗装甲经过强化，能更好地保护穿戴者免受伤害，并且更耐用。\n--\n[c][ff4040]注意：此装甲需要装甲柜来装备。[-][/c]

English: Like a Space Suit, an environmental suit is tough to move around in, but it protects the wearer from nearly all environmental dangers including Heat, Cold, and Radiation. \n--\n[c][ff4040]Note: This armor requires an Armor Locker to equip.[-][/c]
Chinese (simplified): 像太空防护服一样，环境防护服难以移动，但它能保护穿戴者免受几乎所有环境危险，包括高温、寒冷和辐射。\n--\n[c][ff4040]注意：此装甲需要装甲柜来装备。[-][/c]

English: A powerful EVA booster made for extra vechicular combat. WARNING: Only Combat Armors can equip this Boost. Placing this Boost in a non-Combat Armor will destroy the Boost.
Chinese (simplified): 一个强大的舱外活动增强器，用于舱外战斗。警告：只有战斗装甲可以装备此增强器。将本增强器放入非战斗装甲中会摧毁它。

English: A powerful Jetpack Booster that canallow a jetpack to provide extra-vehicular flight. WARNING: Only Scout Armors can equip this boost. Placing this Boost in a non-Scout Armor will destroy the Boost.
Chinese (simplified): 一个强大的喷气背包增强器，可以让喷气背包提供舱外飞行。警告：只有侦察装甲可以装备此增强器。将本增强器放入非侦察装甲中会摧毁它。

English: An environmental Suit intended for space walks. It provides Oxygen and protection against the elements of outer space (Cold and Radiation). \n--\n[c][ff4040]Note: This armor requires an Armor Locker to equip.[-][/c]
Chinese (simplified): 一种用于太空行走的环境防护服。它提供氧气并抵御外层空间的环境因素（寒冷和辐射）。\n--\n[c][ff4040]注意：此装甲需要装甲柜来装备。[-][/c]

English: The Anti-Matter Rifle is a long-range Anti-Material Sniper Rifle that uses explosive pentaxid-infused 'Anti-Matter Bullets' to disintegrate the hull of enemy ships and structures. While the name is misleading, as the rifle doesn't actually use antimatter, the result is similarly devastating to enemy vehicles and bases.
Chinese (simplified): 反物质步枪是一种远程反器材狙击步枪，使用爆炸性的五氧化二钚浸渍“反物质子弹”来瓦解敌方飞船和建筑的结构。虽然名称具有误导性（该步枪实际上并不使用反物质），但其对敌方车辆和基地的破坏效果同样惊人。

English: A marriage between an assault rifle and a sniper rifle, the scout rifle is equipped with the scope of a sniper rifle, but can fire just as fast as an assault rifle, but at a much longer range. While each shot doesn't deal as much damage as a sniper would, the scout rifle's high rate of fire can make short work of nearly any enemy from a distance.
Chinese (simplified): 突击步枪与狙击步枪的结合体，侦察步枪配备了狙击步枪的瞄准镜，但射速与突击步枪一样快，且射程更远。虽然每发子弹的伤害不如狙击步枪，但其高射速可以从远距离快速解决几乎任何敌人。

English: A sniper rifle with a high-powered scope that fires up to three shots in quick succession to quickly take down any foe.
Chinese (simplified): 一把配备高倍瞄准镜的狙击步枪，可快速连续射击三发，迅速击倒任何敌人。

English: Maintains a lock on your Emergency Teleport Chip and teleports you to it when you are severly wounded.
Chinese (simplified): 锁定紧急传送芯片，当你受到重伤时，将你传送至芯片位置。

English: Restores health and has a built in Emergency Teleporter
Chinese (simplified): 恢复生命值，并内置紧急传送器。

English: An advanced medical shower that cures all alements relating to radiation and parasites.
Chinese (simplified): 一种先进的医疗淋浴，可治愈所有与辐射和寄生虫相关的疾病。

English: A type of fuel made from plant protein and a mysterious substance known as Ectoplasm.
Chinese (simplified): 一种由植物蛋白和一种名为“外质”的神秘物质制成的燃料。

English: Stores energy from the Base in a portable Battery. NOTE: As storing the energy requires more energy than is stored, Power Cells are only useful when crafted in Solar-powered Bases.
Chinese (simplified): 将基地的能量储存到便携电池中。注意：储存能量所需的能量多于储存的能量，因此能量电池仅在由太阳能驱动的基地中制造时有用。
地狱风暴导弹炮塔（可伸缩）

English: A rapid-fire Artillery Turret unleashes a barrage of hundreds of Hellfire Missiles down upon its target. -'And you will know my name is the Lord, When I lay my vengeance upon thee!'
Chinese (simplified): 一种速射火炮炮塔，可向目标倾泻数百枚地狱火导弹。——“你将知道我的名是耶和华，当我将我的报复施加于你！”

English: A modified Rocket Launcher that fires volleys of rockets in quick bursts.
Chinese (simplified): 一种改进的火箭发射器，可快速连续发射多枚火箭。

English: Fuel extracted from a small vehicle's Fuel Tank is an admixture of various energy sources. As such, it can only be reused in small vehicle Fuel Tanks.
Chinese (simplified): 从小型飞船燃料箱中提取的燃料是一种多种能源的混合物。因此，它只能重新用于小型飞船燃料箱。

English: Fuel extracted from a Capital Vessel or Base's Fuel Tank is a toxic admixture of various energy sources. As such, it can only be reused in Capital Vessel or Base Fuel Tanks.
Chinese (simplified): 从主力舰或基地燃料箱中提取的燃料是一种多种能源的有毒混合物。因此，它只能重新用于主力舰或基地燃料箱。

English: You can refine a combination of Extracted Fuel and Reclaimed Structure Fuel with Chemicals to create a Recycled Fuel usable by any type of vehicle (but not terrain placeables)
Chinese (simplified): 你可以将提取燃料和回收结构燃料与化学品混合精炼，制成可用于任何类型车辆（但不包括地形可安装设备）的回收燃料。

English: A deployable hover bike made from salvaged material. Once deployed, cannot be repackaged.  NOTE: Does NOT work in Multiplayer.
Chinese (simplified): 一种可部署的悬浮摩托，由回收材料制成。一旦部署，无法重新打包。注意：不适用于多人模式。

English: A deployable Shuttle made from salvaged material, using an advanced Gravitic Thrust Drive, and can be upgraded to fit a variety of roles. Once deployed, it cannot be repackaged.  NOTE: Does NOT work in Multiplayer.
Chinese (simplified): 一种可部署的穿梭机，由回收材料制成，采用先进的重力推进驱动，可升级以适应多种角色。一旦部署，无法重新打包。注意：不适用于多人模式。

English: Reduces the amount of CPU used by your ship by compressing electronic resources into smaller packets.
Chinese (simplified): 通过将电子资源压缩成更小的数据包，减少飞船使用的CPU量。

English: An improvised mechanical Rifle made from scrap metal. Fires shards of junk as ammo.
Chinese (simplified): 一种用废金属制成的简易机械步枪。发射垃圾碎片作为弹药。

English: A deployable turret that automatically targets enemies when powered. Requies Junk Shards as ammo. Once deployed, it cannot be repackaged.  NOTE: Intended for Single Player or Co-Op. Only Game Host can spawn in Co-Op. Does NOT work in Multiplayer.
Chinese (simplified): 一种可部署的炮塔，通电后自动瞄准敌人。需要垃圾碎片作为弹药。一旦部署，无法重新打包。注意：适用于单人或合作模式。合作模式下仅游戏主机可生成。不适用于多人模式。

English: A Makeshift Shotgun built from scrap metal. Fires sharpnel made from Junk Shards.
Chinese (simplified): 一种用废金属制成的简易霰弹枪。发射由垃圾碎片制成的弹片。

English: A Makeshift Minigun built from scrap metal. Fires shards of junk as ammo.
Chinese (simplified): 一种用废金属制成的简易迷你机枪。使用垃圾碎片作为弹药。

English: A Makeshift Rocket Launcher built from scrap metal. Fires rockets made of rubbish as ammo.
Chinese (simplified): 一种用废金属制成的简易火箭发射器。使用垃圾制成的火箭作为弹药。

English: A Rocket made of rubbish and refuse.
Chinese (simplified): 一种由垃圾和废弃物制成的火箭。

English: A biochemical admixture that causes the body to regenerate over time but also increases body radiation. (Heals about 5 health per second for 5 minutes, but increases Radiation .1 every 30 seconds.)
Chinese (simplified): 一种生物化学混合物，能使身体随时间再生，但也会增加身体辐射。（每秒恢复约5生命值，持续5分钟，但每30秒增加0.1辐射。）

English: A more advanced version of the Medical injector which can also revitalize allies and hold many enemies at bay.
Chinese (simplified): 一种更高级的医疗注射器，可以复活盟友并压制多个敌人。

English: A powerful concoction intended to be used as an ammo charge for the Millitary Medical Infuser. \n--\n[c][ff0000]CAUTION:[-][/c] While direct injection can provide healing, this toxic admixture is radioactive when injected and can cause Fever, or Organ Failure which may lead to death.
Chinese (simplified): 一种强效混合物，用作军用医疗注射器的弹药装填。\n--\n[c][ff0000]警告：[-][/c] 虽然直接注射可以治疗，但这种有毒混合物在注射时具有放射性，可能引起发烧或器官衰竭，导致死亡。

English: An artificially created egg substitute. Allow to Set for 30 minutes. Indistinguishable from a natural egg once set.
Chinese (simplified): 一种人工合成的蛋替代品。静置30分钟即可凝固。凝固后与天然蛋无法区分。

English: Uses a combination of ingredients to tear apart and reconstitute an Alien Tooth to make more Alien Teeth. These can be used in place of Alien Teeth in any recipe, including to make more Reconstituted Alien Teeth.
Chinese (simplified): 使用多种成分将外星牙齿分解并重组，制造出更多的外星牙齿。这些牙齿可在任何配方中替代外星牙齿使用，包括制造更多的重组外星牙齿。

English: Used to make Petroleum-based fuels (Gasoline and Diesel Fuel).
Chinese (simplified): 用于制造石油基燃料（汽油和柴油燃料）。

English: Fuel created from Oil Shale that can be used in larger Generators (BA and CV Only).
Chinese (simplified): 由油页岩制成的燃料，可用于大型发电机（仅限基地和主力舰）。

English: Fuel created from Oil Shale that can be used in smaller Generators and Devices (HV, SV, and Terrain Placeables Only). Can be used as fuel for Chainsaws.
Chinese (simplified): 由油页岩制成的燃料，可用于小型发电机和设备（仅限HV、SV和地形可安装设备）。也可作为电锯的燃料。

English: A liquid fuel created by heating promethium to a high temperature and refining it.
Chinese (simplified): 一种通过将钷加热至高温并精炼而成的液体燃料。

English: A hand-held Detector rigged to work in a small vehicle (SV or HV).
Chinese (simplified): 一种手持探测器，改装后可用于小型车辆（SV或HV）。

English: Bio Fuel created from Wood Planks that can be used as fuel with any fuel tank. Can be used as fuel for Chainsaws.
Chinese (simplified): 由木板制成的生物燃料，可作为任何燃料箱的燃料。也可作为电锯的燃料。

English: Bio Fuel created from Grain that can be used as fuel with Small fuel tank (HV and SV Only).
Chinese (simplified): 由谷物制成的生物燃料，可作为燃料用于小型燃料箱（仅限HV和SV）。

English: Bio Fuel created from Vegetables that can be used in larger Generators (BA and CV Only).
Chinese (simplified): 由蔬菜制成的生物燃料，可用于大型发电机（仅限基地和主力舰）。

English: Used to chop wood. Can also be used for a close combat weapon. Can use either Treethanol or Gasoline(Alt Click to select fuel)
Chinese (simplified): 用于砍伐木材。也可作为近战武器。可使用木醇或汽油（Alt点击选择燃料）。
从氧气罐中回收的氧气。

English: In order to save Mass and Volume, you can combine ten Reclaimed Oxygen Bottles into two Large Oxygen Bottles.
Chinese (simplified): 为了节省质量和体积，你可以将十个回收氧气瓶合并成两个大型氧气瓶。

English: A special Repair Bay that can be used to repair Bases, and other Capital Vessels.
Chinese (simplified): 一种特殊的维修舱，可用于维修基地和其他主力舰。

English: An armored plate of Combat Steel to be afixed to a Small Vessel to provice additional protection in combat.
Chinese (simplified): 一种战斗钢装甲板，可安装于小型飞船上，在战斗中提供额外保护。

English: Heavily armored plate of Combat Steel to help protect Bases and Capital Vessles in combat.
Chinese (simplified): 重型战斗钢装甲板，用于在战斗中保护基地和主力舰。

English: An experimental Thruster that creates thrust by accelerating ions using electricity. It uses a large amount of energy, but can output a large amount of thrust for its size. NOTE: Due to its Model (a Block), This device does not appear in the Control Panel, but can be shut off with the 'Thrusters' switch in the Control Panel.
Chinese (simplified): 一种实验性推进器，通过电力加速离子产生推力。能耗巨大，但体积小巧却能输出大量推力。注意：由于其模型（方块），该设备不会出现在控制面板中，但可通过控制面板中的‘推进器’开关关闭。

English: An experimental reactor that acts as both a Fuel Tank and a Generator. Primarily runs on EctoFuel, but can be attached to an external Fuel Tank to utilize other Fuel Sources.
Chinese (simplified): 一种实验性反应堆，兼作燃料罐和发电机。主要使用灵能燃料运行，但可连接外部燃料罐以利用其他燃料源。

English: The gland of a Gaseous Glowbug can be used as a source of energy, but its energy quickly dissipates once the Glowbug dies.
Chinese (simplified): 气体辉光虫的腺体可用作能源，但辉光虫死后能量会迅速消散。

English: A Rocket Launcher fitted to fire large amounts of rockets in rapid succession. Used to rain down destruction on the enemy.
Chinese (simplified): 一种经过改装、能快速连续发射大量火箭的火箭发射器。用于向敌人倾泻毁灭。

English: Tool used for salvaging or removing blocks.
Chinese (simplified): 用于回收或移除方块的工具。

English: A tool used to perform basic repairs on damaged blocks and devices. Requires no ammunition, but will lose durability when used.
Chinese (simplified): 一种用于对受损方块和设备进行基本维修的工具。无需弹药，但使用时消耗耐久度。

English: Allows you to craft Pistol Rounds. Not required if you can craft pistols.
Chinese (simplified): 允许你制造手枪子弹。如果能制造手枪，则不需要此技能。

English: Allows you to craft Projectile Rifle Rounds. Not required if you can craft  Assault Rifles or Pulse Rifles.
Chinese (simplified): 允许你制造射弹步枪子弹。如果能制造突击步枪或脉冲步枪，则不需要此技能。

English: Allows you to craft Shotgun Shells. Not required if you can craft shotguns (not including Junk Shotguns).
Chinese (simplified): 允许你制造霰弹枪弹药。如果能制造霰弹枪（不包括垃圾霰弹枪），则不需要此技能。

English: Allows you to craft Sniper Rifle Rounds. Not required if you can craft Snipers
Chinese (simplified): 允许你制造狙击步枪子弹。如果能制造狙击枪，则不需要此技能。

English: Allows you to craft Minigun Rounds. Not required if you can craft Miniguns.
Chinese (simplified): 允许你制造迷你机枪子弹。如果能制造迷你机枪，则不需要此技能。

English: Allows you to craft 15mm Bullets. Not required if you can craft weapons that use 15mm Bullets (such as Gatling Guns or Minigun Turrets).
Chinese (simplified): 允许你制造15毫米子弹。如果能制造使用15毫米子弹的武器（如加特林机枪或迷你机枪炮塔），则不需要此技能。

English: Allows you to craft 30mm Bullets. Not required if you can craft Cannon Turrets.
Chinese (simplified): 允许你制造30毫米子弹。如果能制造加农炮塔，则不需要此技能。

English:

Chinese (simplified): 这种翘曲引擎比任何其他引擎都能到达更远的地方。它甚至可以用来穿越'光之桥'到达遥远的'失落星系'。消耗的翘曲水晶量只有普通翘曲引擎的一半。

Difficulty: [c][ffff00][b]Medium[/b][-][/c]

As a passenger on board the UES Leo, you awaken from cryo-sleep to find yourself in the wreckage of one of the ship's Cryo Modules. The world outside was once an arid planet with parched mountains, rugged savanna and grueling plains, shriveled lake-beds with the remains of once thriving plant and animal lifethe. However, the Zirax Empire has turned much of this planet into a wasteland, with numerous junkyards around the world. The watertable has become poluted with radiation, and reactor leakage from abandoned vehicles has irradiated the junkyards. The Zirax use  Ripper Dogs to protect the junkyards from would-be scavengers. This hot, dry and unrelenting planet has a thin atmosphere that is un-breathable by humans.



[i]- Cool down with water; generate oxygen with the condenser.

- Hostile weather and aggressive neighbours will arrive. Be prepared.[/i]



NOTE: This starter planet does not allow the use of the Blueprint Factory.

[i]- 用水降温；用冷凝器制造氧气。
